units.title: II. Overview of the extended essay process

outcomes.text: Choose a broad topic, then narrow and focus it.
Decide between a subject-focused and an interdisciplinary pathway.
Choose the approved Diploma subject or subjects for the essay.
Do preparatory reading to build background knowledge.
Plan the research and writing process.
Plan a structure for the essay and adjust it as the research develops.
Include a title page and contents page.
Write an introduction, body and conclusion.
Keep within the 4,000-word limit, which counts introduction, body, conclusion and quotations.
Explain reflection as recapturing experience and thinking about its impact on you as a learner.
Take part in three formal reflection sessions with the supervisor.
Use reflection sessions to review choices and decide whether ideas need changing.
Describe the viva voce as a 10-15 minute interview checking academic integrity and reflecting on what was learned.
Record reflection in a 500-word reflective statement on the Reflection and progress form.
